description:
Use this when the user wants to change a post that is still a draft, or schedule it: "make the caption
        shorter", "move it to Friday 6pm", "turn comments on", "switch it to YouTube", "post it", "schedule it". post_id
        comes from get_post_stats with status "draft". schedule=true schedules the draft so RipClip posts it at its time
        (YouTube Shorts and TikTok now): only after you showed the user this exact post (platform, account, time,
        caption) and they said yes, and only when the connection holds the publish permission (refused otherwise).
        Set only what was asked: caption (replaces the old one; for YouTube its first line is the title), scheduled_at
        (ISO 8601 with its offset) or clear_time, platform, account_id (from list_social_accounts). privacy: TikTok
        public, followers, friends or private; YouTube public, unlisted or private. TikTok post-screen choices, all off
        until the user says: allow_comment, allow_duet, allow_stitch, disclose (then brand_organic = promotes their own
        business, brand_content = a paid partnership), aigc (the label for a video made with AI), mode direct or inbox
        (finish in the TikTok app).
        Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused), new drafts (draft_post, plan_posts) or removing a draft
        (delete_draft). Without schedule=true the draft stays a draft and is never posted. Free.
name: update_draft
title: Update a draft
